name: design
description: Design briefs for static social graphics: quote cards and text graphics, infographics and data viz, YouTube thumbnails, YouTube channel assets (banner, profile picture, watermark, end-screen guide, channel copy), Apple Podcasts show assets (show cover, episode art, small-size previews, show copy), Spotify show assets (feed cover reuse, video-podcast thumbnail, small-size previews, show copy), X profile and post assets (header, profile photo, post and pinned images, alt text, X copy), Pinterest pins, and a brand template system. Writes the brief and a visual-composer composition spec; rendering is compose (or Canva). Mostly adapted from social-media-skills (MIT).
